subject: Pricing & invoicing for compliance add-ons (audit logs, HSM, EU residency)
messages:
From: Lucy Harris <lucy.harris@deepmed.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and invoice mapping

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing vendor comparisons for EU deployments and need a clear line-item pricing breakdown for the following compliance add-ons: audit log retention (90 / 365 / 730 days), KMS/HSM (seat vs usage model), and EU data residency (regional surcharge vs dedicated cluster). Procurement will require the exact invoice mapping (which line items are recurring vs one-time) so our FP&A can model TCO.

A few specific asks:
- Can you provide a per-month and per-token (where applicable) cost for each addon?
- Do you offer a short-term pilot discount for addons while we validate workload patterns?
- How do you present HSM usage vs seat on invoices (separate seat line or blended)?
- Any marketplace listing fees or reseller tax handling we should expect?

I've attached our security questionnaire and procurement checklist for reference.

Thanks —
Lucy Harris
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
DeepMed, Inc.
Attachment: DeepMed_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Harris <lucy.harris@deepmed.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and invoice mapping

Hi Lucy —

Appreciate the clear asks and the questionnaire. High-level answers first, then I attached a detailed spreadsheet with line-item examples (Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v2.xlsx).

Summary (short):
- Audit logs: tiered monthly pricing by retention. 90d = €0.005/GB/mo, 365d = €0.009/GB/mo, 730d = €0.012/GB/mo. Retention is charged per compressed storage plus an indexing fee per 100k events.
- KMS/HSM: two models supported — Seat-based HSM (monthly seat) for FIPS/HSM appliances and Usage-based HSM (per-hour) for cloud-hosted HSM pools. Invoice preference: we recommend the seat model as a separate recurring line ("HSM seat - Redwood") for clarity; usage is billed as a metered line item.
- EU data residency: charged as a regional surcharge (percentage of compute inference spend) when using our EU-only pools: default 12% on top of base inference spend for dedicated clusters; we can also quote a dedicated-residency SKU with a fixed monthly uplift if you need capacity isolation.
- Onboarding: one-time onboarding & compliance validation fee (typically €8,000) — can be amortized into first invoice on request.

Pilot concession: we can offer a 25% discount on addon recurring fees for the first 90 days of a pilot (applies to audit log tiers and HSM seats only). We typically require a short MOU and a PO to lock the pilot pricing.

Invoice mapping example (from attached):
- Line 1: Redwood API usage (tokens) — recurring, metered
- Line 2: Audit log (90/365/730) — recurring, monthly by GB tier
- Line 3: HSM seat <n> — recurring, monthly (separate line)
- Line 4: EU Residency surcharge — recurring, percentage or fixed SKU
- Line 5: One-time onboarding/compliance fee — one-off

I'll loop in Aditya (sales engineering) to confirm any technical constraints for the HSM seat labeling and to help size expected GB/day for audit logs so we can firm actual numbers. Marissa — flagging for approval on the pilot concession.

Next steps: let us know which retention tier you expect to land on and whether you prefer HSM seat vs usage; Aditya can follow up with a short sizing call.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Lucy Harris <lucy.harris@deepmed.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@deepmed.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and invoice mapping

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. Procurement follow-ups:

1) They will insist on separate line items for HSM seats (they do not accept blended service lines). Can you commit to a separate recurring line called exactly "HSM seat (Redwood)"?

2) For audit logs, they want an estimate of monthly GB consumed at our projected ingestion (we're planning ~120M events/day). If you can include a worked example in the spreadsheet showing 120M events/day -> GB/mo for each retention tier that would accelerate approvals.

3) Marketplace: we purchase through a reseller in the EU and will need to know whether Redwood issues a marketplace invoice or if the reseller handles tax. Any experience here?

4) Termination/credits: If we terminate within the pilot, will we be charged the onboarding fee in full? Can that be pro-rated or credited if we run into compliance blockers?

I'll also send you our procurement template if that helps with PO language.

Lucy

Attachment: DeepMed_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (sent by procurement@deepmed.ai)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:00:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons pricing - procurement asks (internal)

Aditya / Marissa —

See procurement items from DeepMed below. Quick thoughts:
- HSM seat labeling: we can put an explicit recurring line "HSM seat (Redwood)" and include seat quantity + seat rate. Margin on seats is healthy; we could concede additional commercial flexibility there.
- Audit log sizing: Aditya, can you add the 120M events/day worked example (GB/month) into the spreadsheet? Also confirm if indexing fee will materially change the numbers.
- Marketplace/tax: Marissa, do we have an established flow with EU resellers around invoicing vs marketplace listing? If not, can legal ops propose a standard clause?
- Onboarding fee: suggest offering to credit 50% of onboarding fee if termination occurs within the 90-day pilot due to unresolvable compliance blockers. That preserves our effort coverage while demonstrating good faith.

If we can move to 30% pilot concession (from 25%) for addons and credit 50% of onboarding on termination, I think this will get procurement to the finish line. Are you comfortable with those moves margin-wise?

Thanks —
Jonas
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Harris <lucy.harris@deepmed.ai>, procurement@deepmed.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 18:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons pricing breakdown and invoice mapping — counterproposal and next steps

Lucy / procurement —

Thanks for the clarifying questions and the procurement checklist. Based on internal review we've prepared a concise counterproposal to keep momentum:

1) Invoice mapping and labels
- We will present HSM as a separate recurring invoice line with label: "HSM seat (Redwood)". Quantity and monthly seat rate will be explicit on the invoice. Usage-based HSM (if selected) will be a separate metered line item.

2) Audit log sizing example
- We've added a worked example in the attached pricing spreadsheet: 120M events/day -> ~18 TB compressed/month (example calculation and assumptions included). Choose retention tier and the spreadsheet will auto-work the monthly charge.

3) Pilot concession & onboarding credit
- Pilot: 30% discount on recurring addon fees (audit logs + HSM seats) for first 90 days.
- Onboarding: standard one-time fee €8,000; if DeepMed terminates within the 90-day pilot due to demonstrable compliance blockers, Redwood will credit 50% (€4,000) back to the customer.

4) EU marketplace/reseller handling
- We have two common patterns: (A) reseller invoices and handles tax (you receive reseller invoice), or (B) Redwood invoices directly with a reseller pass-through. We'll coordinate with your reseller; Marissa will loop legal ops for the standard reseller clause. If reseller requires marketplace listing, we can support (there may be a one-time onboarding for marketplace of €1,000).

5) Minimum commitment to access concession
- To access the 30% pilot concession we request either a short MOU or signed PO covering the pilot scope and expected seat count. If you move to a 12-month committed purchase afterwards we can bake in volume discounts; details in the spreadsheet.

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v2.xlsx (includes worked example), Draft_MutualActionPlan.docx

Next steps:
- Aditya and I can run a 30-minute sizing call this week to finalize GB estimates and seat counts.
- If acceptable, procurement can issue a PO referencing deal DL-78921 and we'll produce a DocuSign amendment for the addon terms.

Happy to hop on a call to walk procurement through invoice examples.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +44 7700 900123
